49039-golden-dreams-and-leaden-realities.title: Leaden Realities.
49039-golden-dreams-and-leaden-realities.creator: Unknown
49039-golden-dreams-and-leaden-realities.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. d into a horse-pond: what is the world coming to? There was no such thing when I was young--we didn't profess then to be wiser than all before us. I'm glad I shall soon be out of the way. And yet I should like to see the end. The end, when will that be? and who can tell what it will be?

57503-irresolute-catherine.title: Irresolute Catherine
57503-irresolute-catherine.creator: Unknown
57503-irresolute-catherine.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. f his neighbours, and his eyes were rather light than dark. But they had a fire, on occasion, that suggested dark things even to the ardent and sober Baptist community to which he belonged. Though he was a young man he looked older than his years by reason of his gauntness and his thin beard.

arxiv-1504-01563.title: "How much?" Is Not Enough An Analysis of Open Budget Initiatives
arxiv-1504-01563.creator: Alan Tygel Judie Attard Fabrizio Orlandi, Maria Luiza Machado Campos Sören Auer
arxiv-1504-01563.description: Abstract A worldwide movement towards the publication of Open Government Data is taking place, and budget data is one of the key elements pushing this trend. Its importance is mostly related to transparency, but publishing budget data, combined with other actions, can also improve democratic participation, allow comparative analysis of governments and boost data-driven business.

arxiv-2102-03719.title: State-Aware Variational Thompson Sampling for Deep Q-Networks Conference: Proc. of the 20th International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems (AAMAS 2021); May 3–7, 2021; Online 417
arxiv-2102-03719.creator: Siddharth Aravindan, Wee Sun Lee
arxiv-2102-03719.description: Abstract . Thompson sampling is a well-known approach for balancing exploration and exploitation in reinforcement learning. It requires the posterior distribution of value-action functions to be maintained; this is generally intractable for tasks that have a high dimensional state-action space.

arxiv-2102-08686.title: Fully General Online Imitation Learning
arxiv-2102-08686.creator: Michael K. Cohen michael.cohen@eng.ox.ac.uk, Marcus Hutter hutter1.net, Neel Nanda neelnanda.io
arxiv-2102-08686.description: Abstract In imitation learning, imitators and demonstrators are policies for picking actions given past interactions with the environment. If we run an imitator, we probably want events to unfold similarly to the way they would have if the demonstrator had been acting the whole time. In general, one mistake during learning can lead to completely different events.

Park is with the School of Information Technology,
arxiv-2112-01765.creator: Ju-Hyung Lee, Hyowoon Seo, Jihong Park
arxiv-2112-01765.description: Abstract A mega-constellation of low-altitude earth orbit (LEO) satellites (SATs) are envisaged to provide a global coverage SAT network in beyond fifth-generation (5G) cellular systems. LEO SAT networks exhibit extremely long link distances of many users under time-varying SAT network topology.

arxiv-2402-13719.title: Informative simultaneous confidence intervals for graphical test procedures
arxiv-2402-13719.creator: Werner Brannath, Liane Kluge, Martin Scharpenberg
arxiv-2402-13719.description: Abstract Simultaneous confidence intervals (SCIs) that are compatible with a given closed test procedure are often non-informative. More precisely, for a one-sided null hypothesis, the bound of the SCI can stick to the border of the null hypothesis, irrespective of how far the point estimate deviates from the null hypothesis.

arxiv-2402-18686.title: Constraints on the mass of a bosonic dark matter candidate within the DD2Y-T model
arxiv-2402-18686.creator: Mahboubeh Shahrbaf, Davood Rafiei Karkevandi, Stefan Typel
arxiv-2402-18686.description: Abstract Dark matter remains a topic of ongoing controversy. It has gained attention in the theoretical description of compact objects such as neutron stars with cores of very dense matter. Various candidates have been proposed for dark matter in the scientific literature.

arxiv-2406-16565.title: Noisy Neighbors : Efficient membership inference attacks against LLMs
arxiv-2406-16565.creator: Filippo Galli, Luca Melis, Tommaso Cucinotta
arxiv-2406-16565.description: Abstract The potential of transformer-based LLMs risks being hindered by privacy concerns due to their reliance on extensive datasets, possibly including sensitive information. Regulatory measures like GDPR and CCPA call for using robust auditing tools to address potential privacy issues, with Membership Inference Attacks (MIA) being the primary method for assessing LLMs’ privacy risks.

arxiv-2509-22007.title: Stage-wise Dynamics of Classifier-Free Guidance in Diffusion Models
arxiv-2509-22007.creator: Cheng Jin, Qitan Shi & Yuantao Gu
arxiv-2509-22007.description: Abstract Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) is widely used to improve conditional fidelity in diffusion models, but its impact on sampling dynamics remains poorly understood. Prior studies, often restricted to unimodal conditional distributions or simplified cases, provide only a partial picture. We analyze CFG under multimodal conditionals and show that the sampling process unfolds in three successive stages.

arxiv-2602-13986.title: Spectral Theory of Fractional Cooperative Systems and Threshold Dynamics in Epidemic Models
arxiv-2602-13986.creator: Cong-Bang Trang, Hoang-Hung Vo
arxiv-2602-13986.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Cong-Bang Trang, Hoang-Hung Vo. The spectral analysis has long been recognized as a fundamental tool in the study of existence, uniqueness and qualitative behavior of solutions to semilinear elliptic and parabolic equations, as well as their long-time dynamics. In the contemporary mathematics, fractional Laplacian are used to model nonlocal or long-range diffusion processes in biology, such as anomalous movement, long-distance dispersal, or Lévy-flight migration of organisms, cells, epidemic.

pmc-10588729.title: Acute Stroke at Term Pregnancy: What Should Happen Before the Epidural?
pmc-10588729.creator: Sujeivan Mahendram, Kenneth Eichenbaum
pmc-10588729.description: Acute stroke is a time-sensitive medical diagnosis, and current standardized management algorithms do not specifically streamline care for pregnant patients with these symptoms. Here, we discuss the management of a 29-year-old parturient with a history of systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) who presented with stroke-like symptoms.

pmc-10616507.title: Structural basis for severe pain caused by mutations in the voltage sensors of sodium channel NaV1.7
pmc-10616507.creator: Goragot Wisedchaisri, Tamer M. Gamal El-Din, Natasha M. Powell, Ning Zheng, William A. Catterall
pmc-10616507.description: Mutations in the voltage-gated sodium channel NaV1.7 cause the chronic pain syndrome, inherited erythromelalgia. Structures of bacterial sodium channel NaVAb with these mutations revealed changes that would enhance the outward movement of the gating charges and lead to hyperexcitability underlying chronic pain. Introduction Voltage-gated sodium (NaV) channels initiate and propagate action potentials in nerve and muscle.

pmc-11429483.title: In Vivo Effect of Halicin on Methicillin-Resistant Staphylococcus aureus-Infected Caenorhabditis elegans and Its Clinical Potential
pmc-11429483.creator: Li-Ting Kao, Tsung-Ying Yang, Wei-Chun Hung, Wei-Te Yang, Pu He, Bo-Xuan Chen, Yu-Chi Wang, Shiou-Sheng Chen, Yu-Wei Lai, Hsian-Yu Wang, Sung-Pin Tseng, William R Schwan, Mehran Monchi
pmc-11429483.description: Recently, the high proportion of methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus infections worldwide has highlighted the urgent need for novel antibiotics to combat this crisis. The recent progress in computational techniques for use in health and medicine, especially artificial intelligence (AI), has created new and potential approaches to combat antibiotic-resistant bacteria, such as repurposing existing drugs, optimizing current agents, and designing novel compounds.

pmc-11592284.title: The Effect of Bone Mechanical Stress Caused by Electrical Stimulation-Induced Muscle Contraction on Osteocalcin Secretion
pmc-11592284.creator: Yi-Chen Chen, Ryoya Oga, Takahiro Furumi, Koki Nakagawa, Yoshihiro Nita, Hiroyuki Tamaki
pmc-11592284.description: Simple SummaryElectrical stimulation-induced muscle contraction (ESMC) is a well-known rehabilitation method used to prevent muscle loss. During exercise, muscle contractions create strain on bones, which can lead to the release of undercarboxylated osteocalcin, a hormone produced by bones that is linked to improved insulin sensitivity and other health benefits.

pmc-12697872.title: Rethinking the AI Paradigm for Solubility Prediction of Drug‑Like Compounds with Dual‐Perspective Modeling and Experimental Validation
pmc-12697872.creator: Qilin Zhu, Yuxin Qiu, Guzhong Chen, Wenyao Chen, Xiang Zhang, Zhiwen Qi, Xuezhi Duan, De Chen, Zhen Song
pmc-12697872.description: Aqueous solubility is a crucial property for drug development, as it not only influences the drug delivery process but also determines the bioavailability of drugs. However, solubility prediction remains a formidable challenge, even after decades of research. Most previously‐reported machine learning (ML) models generalize poorly on external sets due to the vast chemical space of drug compounds.

pmc-13190752.title: Prognostic and Treatment-Associated Survival Effects of Microsatellite Instability Across Disease Stages in Colon Cancer: An NCDB Analysis
pmc-13190752.creator: Mohyeddine El Sayed, Sassine Youssef, Maha Chaccour, Melhem El Harati
pmc-13190752.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundMicrosatellite instability (MSI) is an established molecular biomarker in colorectal cancer (CRC). However, its stage-specific prognostic value and treatment-modifying role in colon cancer remain incompletely defined, particularly across contemporary multimodality treatment strategies.MethodsWe conducted a retrospective cohort study using the National Cancer Database, including patients aged ≥ 20 years diagnosed with colon cancer between 2004 and 2020 with documented tumor stage and MSI status. MSI was categorized as microsatellite stable (MSS), MSI-low (MSI-L), or MSI-high (MSI-H).

pmc-13273123.title: Serum Klotho as a potential biomarker for prognosis in acute ischemic stroke
pmc-13273123.creator: Fangfang Bi, Juning Wang, Mingquan Su
pmc-13273123.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectiveTo investigate the association between serum Klotho levels and 90-day functional outcome in patients with acute ischemic stroke (AIS), and to assess its potential as a short-term prognostic biomarker.MethodsThis single-center retrospective observational cohort study included 200 patients with AIS. Patients were divided into favorable outcome group [90-day modified Rankin Scale (mRS) 0–2, n = 140] and unfavorable outcome group (mRS 3–6, n = 60). Unfavorable 90-day outcome was used as the binary dependent variable. Baseline characteristics were compared between groups.

pmc-13488574.title: The UN Decade of healthy ageing in practice: A qualitative case study on perspectives of healthy ageing among older adults, healthcare professionals, and decision-makers in Norway
pmc-13488574.creator: Mariya Bikova, Maria Nordheim Alme, Djenana Jalovcic, Hanne Tuntland
pmc-13488574.description: BackgroundGlobal populations are ageing, making healthy ageing an increasingly important priority. In Norway, the number of people aged 70 and above is expected to double by 2050. The UN Decade of Healthy Ageing (2021–2030) guides Norway’s national programs on healthy ageing through its four action areas: combating ageism, age-friendly environments, integrated care and long-term care.

pmc-13562630.title: RTD-YOLO: a precise quality detection and grading model for rose tea
pmc-13562630.creator: Zezhong Ding, Zhiwei Chen, Bin Hu, Chunwang Dong
pmc-13562630.description: Against the backdrop of the increasingly prominent commercial value of roses, rose tea with uneven quality levels has no competitive advantage. To enhance the market competitiveness of rose tea, it is necessary to classify it. At present, the grading of rose tea mainly relies on manual labor, which is inefficient.

pmc-13679811.title: Rare presentation of hydrocephalus occlusus caused by membranous obstruction of the foramina of Magendie and Luschka: a case report
pmc-13679811.creator: Sergio Calero Martinez, Lydia Karamani, Heike de Vries, Paul-Christian Krüger, Christian Senft, Nazeer Aboud
pmc-13679811.description: Fourth ventricle outlet obstruction is a rare cause of obstructive hydrocephalus in children. Although surgical management has been reported, the diagnostic challenges, differential considerations, and therapeutic strategies remain debated. We report a 5-year-old boy with progressive vomiting, severe headache, gait instability, and incontinence.
